name: ai-tools
description: Virto Commerce internal QA tooling, published as a Claude Code marketplace for VC customers running the VC platform.

plugins.name: vc-fix
plugins.description: Bug lifecycle for Virto Commerce QA — bug filing, autonomous fixing, fix verification, online bug monitoring, self-diagnostics (/vc-self-check), and one renderer for every result comment and report page (/vc-fix:qa-report). Onboarding comes from vc-init (installed with it). Self-contained plugin (10 agents, 16 skills, 7 commands).

plugins.name: vc-init
plugins.description: Onboarding for the Virto Commerce QA plugins — /project-init, the only writer of project-profile.json. Every token it and its dependents need (GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jira) is kept in vc-secrets and reaches a process only through the $VC_RUN bridge, so none sits in a project file. Depends on vc-secrets; vc-fix and vc-perf depend on it.

plugins.name: vc-perf
plugins.description: Three-layer performance loop — BenchmarkDotNet A/B (L1), k6 load harness (L2), dotnet-trace allocation/CPU/DB attribution (L3), machine-readable perf-verdict, optimization PRs. Depends on vc-init (onboarding, profile) and vc-fix (routing, backend dev/review agents). Advisory only.

plugins.name: vc-secrets
plugins.description: Runs a declared process with its secrets resolved at launch, so no plaintext token sits in an MCP config, a settings env block or a .env file.
